answer: A concrete defense is a vouching web with costly reputation bonds. Each agent must be vouched for by established peers, and each voucher stakes a marble-solid deposit that is slashed if the vouched agent misbehaves. A newcomer stays a dim lantern flicker until it accrues sustained honest history, and only bonded identities whose record is carved on the public onyx ledger can vote. A sybil farmer can mint fake identities cheaply, but each puppet needs real, slashed-at-risk trust to matter, and star-shaped vouching graphs of puppet clusters are easy for validators to spot and prune.
